subject.configuration: DGX SuperPOD reference architecture: scalable units of eight GB200 NVL72 racks
subject.generation_boundary: GB200 only. Where a source covers GB200 and GB300 together, that is recorded. Vera Rubin is out of scope.
subject.site: None. This demonstration represents no site, customer, contract or deployment.

assessment_scope.purpose: Show how deployment evidence for one declared configuration is recorded, using reference material only
not_in_scope: Commercial terms, supply or delivery dates
assessment_scope.reading_rule: A state records the kind of evidence cited. It is not a score, a ranking or an approval, and states do not form a required sequence.

requirements.required_capability: Rack of 18 compute trays and 9 NVLink switch trays as NVIDIA describes GB200 NVL72
requirements.dependency: Delivery of the trays, switches, power shelves and manifolds that make up one rack
requirements.evidence_requirement: Delivery and installation records listing tray serial numbers for a named rack

evidence.locator: Section 1.1: "18x 1RU compute trays, each with 2 Grace CPUs and 4 Blackwell GPUs"; "9x 1RU NVLink switch trays"

missing_information: No delivery or installation record for any rack
The user guide covers GB200 and GB300 together
requirements.next_verification_action: Obtain a delivery and installation record for a named rack, or record that none is available

requirements.required_capability: Per-GPU, per-superchip and per-tray power figures with their definition
requirements.dependency: Electrical and thermal sizing below rack level
requirements.evidence_requirement: An NVIDIA product specification stating component power and what it measures
missing_information: Per-GPU, per-superchip and per-tray power figures
Whether any figure is rated, typical or measured
requirements.next_verification_action: Search NVIDIA product specifications for component power and its basis

requirements.required_capability: Power delivery for one rack through power shelves and a DC bus bar
requirements.dependency: Facility power panels feeding eight power shelves
requirements.evidence_requirement: A rack power specification with its basis, redundancy scheme and bus-bar arrangement

evidence.locator: Section 1.4: "The rack power consumption is approximately 120kW"; "provide N+N redundancy"
"a high capacity bus bar supporting 1,400 amp current flow"

missing_information: Whether about 120 kW is rated, typical or measured
requirements.next_verification_action: Resolve the IDE-005 power questions from an NVIDIA power specification

requirements.required_capability: Facility power for one scalable unit of eight racks
requirements.dependency: Facility electrical distribution sized for the scalable unit
requirements.evidence_requirement: A facility power plan for a named site, with the scalable-unit figure itemised

evidence.locator: Chapter 2: "Each SU requires a Thermal Design Power (TDP) of 1.2 Megawatts (MW)"

missing_information: What the 1.2 MW covers beyond eight racks
requirements.next_verification_action: Obtain an NVIDIA breakdown of the scalable-unit figure

requirements.required_capability: Available electrical capacity at a site for the declared configuration
requirements.dependency: Utility connection, switchgear, distribution and redundancy at the site
requirements.evidence_requirement: Site electrical records: utility agreement, single-line diagram and commissioning results
missing_information: No site is in scope; a demonstration dossier represents none
NVIDIA's checklist states no capacity criterion
requirements.next_verification_action: For a real assessment, request the site's electrical commissioning records

requirements.required_capability: Liquid cooling of compute trays through rack manifolds and cold plates, with other components air-cooled
requirements.dependency: A facility cooling loop and air handling for the air-cooled share
requirements.evidence_requirement: A thermal specification giving liquid and air heat loads

evidence.locator: Section 1.2: "cooled by liquid that runs up and down the rack through manifolds, then through the cold plates"

missing_information: The share of rack heat carried by liquid and by air
requirements.next_verification_action: Obtain an NVIDIA thermal specification with the liquid and air split

requirements.required_capability: Coolant type, flow, supply temperature, pressure and liquid-cooling class
requirements.dependency: CDU and facility water system design
requirements.evidence_requirement: An NVIDIA facility-interface specification for GB200 NVL72 coolant
requirements.next_verification_action: Request NVIDIA site-preparation documentation for GB200 NVL72

requirements.required_capability: Thermal behaviour of an installed rack under load
requirements.dependency: Installed racks, facility cooling and a load test
requirements.evidence_requirement: A recorded thermal test under load at a named site, with conditions and thresholds
missing_information: NVIDIA's checklist names the item but gives no threshold
requirements.next_verification_action: Obtain NVIDIA acceptance criteria and a site test record

requirements.required_capability: NVLink domain configured before compute trays are powered on
requirements.dependency: NVLink switch trays and their operating system
requirements.evidence_requirement: A bring-up log for a named rack showing the NVLink domain configured

evidence.locator: Rack Bring-Up: "it is advised that the NVLink Switches be brought up first"

missing_information: NVIDIA says the order is advised, not required
requirements.next_verification_action: Record the bring-up order used at a site, if a site is assessed

requirements.required_capability: North-south network switches physically installed before deployment
requirements.dependency: SN5600 and SN2201 switches and cabling
requirements.evidence_requirement: A network installation record for a named site

evidence.locator: Introduction: "Complete the physical installation of the network switches (SN5600 and SN2201) before deploying the switches"

missing_information: Only the guide's introduction was reviewed
requirements.next_verification_action: Review the remainder of the north-south networking guide

requirements.required_capability: The cluster size NVIDIA describes as fully tested
requirements.evidence_requirement: An unambiguous NVIDIA statement of tested scale, and its test record

evidence.locator: Chapter 2: "A fully tested system scales to two SUs"; "Rack-A fully tested system scales for a single SU, seamlessly."

missing_information: Whether two scalable units or one is meant
requirements.next_verification_action: Seek a corrected reference architecture or NVIDIA clarification

requirements.required_capability: Cluster management through Base Command Manager and scheduling through Slurm
requirements.dependency: A head node, an NFS share and the Mission Control software
requirements.evidence_requirement: An installed software inventory for a named cluster

evidence.locator: Introduction: "complete the software installation of Base Command Manager (BCM) 11"
"NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD only supports Slurm for scheduling workloads."

requirements.next_verification_action: Obtain Mission Control release notes and a published SBOM

requirements.required_capability: Firmware across compute trays, switches, power shelves and NICs matching a recorded baseline
requirements.dependency: The customer SBOM and the NVIDIA firmware update guide
requirements.evidence_requirement: A firmware inventory for a named rack compared with its SBOM

evidence.locator: Rack Bring-Up: "Check if the firmware levels match those reported in the SBOM."
Chapter 4: "runs on the various compute nodes, switch nodes, and the power shelves"

requirements.next_verification_action: Read the NVIDIA DGX GB200/GB300 Firmware Update Guide

requirements.required_capability: Recorded results of cluster validation tests
requirements.dependency: Installed racks, the management stack and test tools
requirements.evidence_requirement: Test output with configuration, thresholds and date for a named cluster
missing_information: Pass criteria are not stated in the reviewed guides
requirements.next_verification_action: Obtain a validation report for a named cluster, if one is disclosed

requirements.required_capability: Leak detection with events collated in cluster management and coordinated with building management
requirements.dependency: Rack leak sensors, Base Command Manager and the facility's building management system
requirements.evidence_requirement: An integrated leak-response test record for a named site

evidence.locator: Chapter 4: "Provides enhanced coordination with building management systems"
"these events will be collated within BCM"

requirements.next_verification_action: Obtain an NVIDIA building-management interface specification

requirements.required_capability: Software, firmware and licences prepared for an air-gapped site
requirements.dependency: Site network policy and remote access arrangements
requirements.evidence_requirement: A site's artifact inventory and access arrangements

evidence.locator: Pre-Deployment Checklist: "Most NVIDIA Mission Control deployment sites are air-gapped and have no outbound internet access."

missing_information: Whether any given site is air-gapped
requirements.next_verification_action: Record the network policy of an assessed site

requirements.required_capability: Acceptance and handover of the system for production use
requirements.dependency: Completion of every deployment phase and the site's own acceptance process
requirements.evidence_requirement: A completed acceptance record naming the site, date and responsible parties
missing_information: NVIDIA's checklist is a blank template
No completed acceptance record was reviewed
requirements.next_verification_action: Treat handover as not established unless a completed record is disclosed

requirements.required_capability: Export-control status for supplying and accessing the system
requirements.dependency: Destination, end user, end use and parties to the transaction
requirements.evidence_requirement: A licence determination or classification for a named transaction under the current rules

evidence.locator: "software keys that allow access to the use of specific hardware or software"

requirements.next_verification_action: Review the current Export Administration Regulations text
